_comment: Launcher configuration for the simulation-only gradient-descent sweep that provides the `simulation` source in scored.json and the seed holograms for the simulation-seeded initialization. This file has been edited for public release: paths are now relative to the deposit root and resolved by code/analysis/paths.py, and settings belonging to methods not reported in this paper removed. See README.md.

experiment.name: simulation_comparison
experiment.description: Gradient-descent phase retrieval against the simulated forward model, swept over iteration budget, on all 18 targets. The 750-iteration result is the no-feedback baseline reported in the paper and the seed for the simulation-seeded initialization. Run under two target formulations: 'amplitude' is the published convention and writes to gd/; 'intensity' is additional and writes to the namespaced sibling gd_intensity_target/. Note that gd.run squares an amplitude target to recover the intensity training target, so the loss is formed in intensity either way.
